{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar''' is an optional internal ship module used to carry and deploy the [[Rhino]] [[Surface Recon Vehicles|Surface Recon Vehicle]]. The Rhino is too large for the ordinary cargo-hatch deployment used by smaller SRVs, so it drops from this dedicated large-vehicle bay.<ref name="frontier-first-look">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/beneath-surface-your-first-look-rhino Beneath the Surface – Your First Look at the Rhino], Frontier Developments, 6 August 2026. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref>

== Compatibility ==

Frontier's live-release announcement lists the following ship and hangar-class combinations.<ref name="frontier-release">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/rhino-available-now-arx-early-access Rhino – Available Now Via ARX Early Access], Frontier Developments, 2 September 2026. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref>

The Keelback has the narrowest supported range. A ship not present in Frontier's compatibility list should not be assumed to accept the module merely because it can carry an ordinary [[Planetary Vehicle Hangar]] or another launch-bay type.

== Acquisition and fitting ==

The Rhino Standard store page states that the hangar is not part of the vehicle bundle itself, but becomes available for compatible ships at most outfitting locations and is free with the Rhino purchase.<ref name="store-standard">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/store/product/rhino-standard Rhino Standard], Elite Dangerous Gamestore, Frontier Developments. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref>

The fitted ship still needs enough optional-internal space for a supported module class. Cargo racks, shields, and other internals compete for the remaining slots, so carrier-ship choice affects how much room is left for mined cargo.

== Deployment behaviour ==

The hangar stores the Rhino aboard a compatible ship and handles its large-vehicle deployment. Frontier describes the Rhino as being dropped from the bay rather than lowered through the regular SRV cargo hatch.<ref name="frontier-first-look" />

For the complete preparation, deployment, recovery, and cargo-transfer sequence, see [[Surface Mining with the Rhino]].

== Limitations ==

* The module is available in the current Live game and is tied to Rhino access.
* Only the compatible ships and class ranges listed above are confirmed by Frontier's live-release material.
* The ordinary Planetary Vehicle Hangar remains the established module for smaller SRVs.
* Compatibility with fighter or ship-launched-vessel bays does not imply compatibility with the Rhino hangar.
